risks: Formula recalculation dependency graph fidelity not guaranteed by kernel alone
Accessibility conformance for all interactive elements (e.g., ARIA tab behavior) must be validated separately
validation_focus: Workbook and worksheet structural operations preserve data integrity
Formula evaluation matches documented spreadsheet semantics
All user-facing dialogs and menus meet WCAG 2.1 AA contrast and keyboard navigation requirements
contract.rationale: All atomic requirements map directly to the 'sheet' domain capabilities: workbook creation/import/export/rename (workbook_lifecycle), worksheet add/switch/rename/delete (reversible_structure), cell editing/pasting/selection/cut-copy-paste/undo-redo (cell_editing + clipboard_and_menus + reversible_structure), formula entry/recalculation/error-handling/reference-adjustment (formulas), sort/filter/va
